title: Align round87 publication helper dispositions with the native finding-status enum
body:
The independently reviewed round87 hosted package selector and manifest builder used `dismissed` as a terminal native finding status. The current review contract uses `rejected`. A valid rejected finding would therefore fail these publication selectors, although the current cohort has not demonstrated a hosted runtime failure and no record science is implicated.

Preserved finding: `HP1`, stable key `round87-hosted-native-finding-status`.

- Initial observation: `reviews/publication/20261015-round87/cmm-round87-hosted-static-initial-20261015T034920Z.json`, with immutable module snapshot SHA256 `2b604b672732057f211aa8cf183785532838578c4964f11b1c4bf4388a624867`.
- Expanded observation: `reviews/publication/20261015-round87/cmm-round87-hosted-static-expanded-20261015T035023Z.json`, which captures both exact occurrences and corrects the initial line-number transcription without overwriting it. Module expression is line50; builder expression is line25.
- Original builder snapshot SHA256 `b2564ee3e322b0f92e0331594e24a615e240202df01f0a23b30fadcd7b794251`.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Use `resolved` and `rejected` in both selectors while retaining exact predecessor occurrence, target, stable-key and hash checks.
2. Keep `open`, `deferred`, schema-invalid `dismissed` and unassessed `accepted_risk` outside positive publication acceptance.
3. Exercise the actual parsed helper predicates/functions with meaningful positive rejected/resolved cases and negative invalid/unresolved cases; retain original and corrected receipts.
4. Save an independent successor that explicitly binds both original observations, both corrected helper hashes and the focused fixture results. Do not rewrite immutable scientific reviews or imply that static checks establish actual PR/CI success.

Both corrections are already prepared after the independent initial captures; the issue records the review defect and its evidence-backed resolution through the authorized PR.

The initial observations, exact source snapshots, correction receipts, focused fixture sources/results and independent successor will be included under `reviews/publication/20261015-round87/` in the resolving PR. Local acquisition paths remain only as provenance inside those artifacts.

title: Clarify the Qu2023 simonkolleite run inventory, solution units and thermal protocol
body:
The new simonkolleite record can retain the narrowly supported abiotic phase observations from Qu et al. (2023), DOI [10.1039/D3NA00108C](https://doi.org/10.1039/d3na00108c), while leaving the following reproducibility questions open. This is an upstream source-clarification task, not evidence that the current qualified record is incorrect.

The complete published-version article was acquired from [White Rose](https://eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/197511/1/d3na00108c.pdf), 17 PDF pages including a repository cover, SHA256 `54c0e0eae009ecf769acb2447cf6a7772b02b562a2b37e934d8431108f062c00`. The official full JATS at [Europe PMC](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC10153477/fullTextXML), SHA256 `297c9a200e88e9f3e8fae678dfdcdd8c21a0fa3405670db3b851760f676a160a`, corroborates the wording. All main Figures 1–16 and Table 1 were inspected. The Europe PMC supplementaryFiles archive contains main figure images, not a separate methods supplement; no separate SI was announced in the inspected article. This is a bounded access assessment, not a claim that additional author data cannot exist.

Confirmed discrepancies:

- Methods give 15 mL solution for the 40 °C experiments and 10 mL for the 160 °C arm, while Table 1 labels those same entries as grams (repository PDF page 4). No density allowing these to be equated is supplied. The section heading also says room temperature while the actual setting is 40 °C.
- Methods/Table 1 list 1, 3, 5, 7 and 15 days. Figures 4–5 and 14 instead use a ten-day 10% product; Figure 9 starts with a two-day 40% sample after the stated one-day nonprecipitation result (PDF pages 4, 6, 9–10 and 13). These may be additional runs, but their provenance is not documented in the listed matrix.
- Characterisation Methods specify TGA to 800 °C, whereas Results, Figure 13 and the Figure 14a axis use 900 °C (PDF pages 5 and 11–13). The Figure 13 morphology sample is labelled 15-day synthesis, while Figure 14 uses a ten-day product. Staged 100/250/400/600 °C runs lack separately specified hold/ramp details.
- Introduction describes scrap zinc, but Methods specify purchased 99.8% zinc grains; the Conclusion additionally says oxidation of ZnO despite the metal feed in Methods (PDF pages 4 and 14). No real-scrap processing claim should be inferred.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Locate a published correction, deposited run log, supplementary protocol or other attributable primary clarification that maps each figure to its synthesis run, feed provenance, solution amount/unit, concentration, duration and heating program. Do not silently normalize conflicting units or assume that the ten-day and fifteen-day samples are identical.
2. Verify any clarification against the original figure/data identifiers, retain its source/version/access date and hashes, and preserve the original account in the dossier.
3. Reassess only the affected record fields through a new canonical EDIT and independent scientific successor if the clarification warrants a change. Until then retain the stated uncertainties; do not convert thermal residue mass or diffraction-peak disappearance into zinc recovery yield or quantitative phase purity.

Deduplication: the current round87 all-state issue inventory was checked by material name and DOI with no matching issue found. Maintained records/research/reviews/history in both the isolated worktree and original checkout were searched with hidden and ignored files included and relevant symlinks followed, together with the cited round76/79/85/86 and round29 raw roots. Prior simonkolleite content was a deferred round86 source lead, not an accepted owner of this experiment.

title: Clarify secondary aluminium dross roasting recipe and mass-balance basis in Lv et al. (2022)
body:
Lv et al., *Effective Extraction of the Al Element from Secondary Aluminum Dross Using a Combined Dry Pressing and Alkaline Roasting Process*, DOI [10.3390/ma15165686](https://doi.org/10.3390/ma15165686), supplies the complete primary evidence for the new secondary-aluminium-dross owner. The official 16-page PDF and full original XML have been acquired; this is a source-clarification follow-up, not a missing-paper or current record defect.

The record preserves two limitations that prevent a unique reproduction recipe and an overall product-recovery claim:

- Table 2 (PDF page 6) gives the carbonate-ratio series at 1100°C and 60 min leaching; the abstract and §3.5/Table 4 (pages 1 and 13) give the selected condition at 1150°C and 30 min. The source does not clearly connect every recovery datum to one of these conditions. Figure 5’s caption also swaps the b/c descriptions relative to the actual axes and alkali labels. The caustic liquor is specified as C(Na2O) = 60 g/L and alpha_k = 3.0 without a complete preparation recipe.
- Equations 1–2 (§2.3, page 5) use Mg-normalized clinker/residue compositions and contain incomplete brackets. The reported 90.79% Al and 92.03% Na values concern this solid-balance estimate, with added sodium reagents. Independent solution inventory, conserved-Mg verification, roasting/filtration/wash losses and isolated alumina yield are not supplied. Lower N/Cl concentrations are not a complete gas/emissions or detoxification balance.

Acceptance requires a legitimate original supplement, deposited raw data, published correction or comparably attributable clarification that:

1. maps each adopted recovery result to its exact roasting temperature, duration, reagent ratio and full leaching-liquor recipe, including the 30/60 min discrepancy;
2. defines the balance equations unambiguously and documents the relevant solid, solution and loss terms, including whether magnesium was conserved and whether washes were included;
3. provides direct evidence before adding any isolated alumina yield, condensate-purity, complete detoxification or industrial-deployment assertion.

Until then, retain the qualified laboratory chemical-extraction record and its original source discrepancies. No author contact, guessed corrected values or transfer of unrelated aluminium-smelting-slag bioleaching results is requested.
